eval_cmd: cd {cwd} && bash eval.sh dev | tee /tmp/arbor_eval_{node_id}_dev.log && python3 -c "import re,json; out=open('/tmp/arbor_eval_{node_id}_dev.log').read(); s=re.findall(r'score: ([0-9.]+)', out); print(json.dumps({'score': float(s[-1])}))"
eval_cmd_test: cd {cwd} && bash eval.sh test | tee /tmp/arbor_eval_{node_id}_test.log && python3 -c "import re,json; out=open('/tmp/arbor_eval_{node_id}_test.log').read(); s=re.findall(r'score: ([0-9.]+)', out); print(json.dumps({'score': float(s[-1])}))"
dataset_info: GSM8K answer selection. data/dev/items.jsonl (1000 items = 5 models x 200) and data/test/items.jsonl (1319 items). Each item: uid, model (diffugpt-s/diffugpt-m/diffullama/dream-base/llada-base), question, candidates[10] with {text, answer (extracted number or None), features}. Features: ar.{gpt2,qwen0.5b,tinyllama,qwen7b,llama2-7b}.{nll_sum,n_tokens}, len_chars. Gold in gold.jsonl (never passed to select()). B_dev=dev (iteration), B_test=test (merge gate + final). Score = macro-avg accuracy over the 5 models; higher is better. Only solution.py may be edited; static check restricts imports to stdlib whitelist (math, re, collections, statistics, itertools, functools, heapq, bisect, typing), forbids open/exec/eval etc.
